[RARC.4.4] **Migration tools.** A one-shot batch translator is
a separate binary, not a feature of the runtime. A v(N-1)→v(N)
translator is permitted but lives outside the engine and is
itself version-discipline-bound: a v(N+1) runtime does not
ship the v(N-1)→v(N) translator. The same rule applies
transitively.
